company.description:
MICEit.co is first venue booking and event management engine for MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conventions & Exhibitions) related events in Jordan. Providing a one stop-shop platform, connecting both service providers and event organizers in one portal.
This integrated platform combines various MICE event requirements, such as: venue booking, audio visual equipment, event management, concierge services, travel requirements and much more.
